steps.label: Dive from Grace
steps.note:
Toolbox originally by Day Lights.

Edited by Atmus Coldheart.
Revamp by Evansith

After the Final Chorus transition and 3 line-cleaving autos, the boss casts "Dive from Grace"

steps.label: Setup
steps.note:
Dive from Grace (Wyrmhole):
-Three "First in Line" (I) debuffs, two "Second in Line" (II) debuffs, and three "Third in Line" (III)) debuffs. These indicate when Nidstinien will drop on you. -After being dropped on, you will spawn a tower that SOMEONE ELSE in the party must soak. After they soak the tower, a Nidstinien clone will appear on the tower, and the soaker must point it away from the party.

Additionally, One or Two groups of numbers will receive an up arrow and down debuff amongst them. These debuffs, along with the crosshair, indicate where you will spawn a tower after getting hit with your dive. 

-An up arrow (Spineshatter Dive) means your tower will spawn in front of you.
 
-A down arrow (Elusive Jump) means it will spawn behind you. 

-Prey (High Jump) means it will spawn directly on you.

Throughout this mechanic everyone will get hit by a dive and need to soak a tower at different times as detailed in the following steps.

steps.label: Lash and Gnash Cast
steps.note:
Nidhogg will begin casting Gnash and Lash, or Lash and Gnash.
Gnash = Out
Lash = In

He will cast it twice during this phase, and it is not guaranteed to be opposite.

Party stack north on boss.

1's position to place their towers on the edge of the bosses hitbox in the position they indicated during setup.

Gnash and Lash come out surprisingly slowly. Be aware!

steps.label: 1s Placed
steps.note:
When the castbar completes, 1's will be hit, they will lose their debuffs, and receive a fire vuln stopping them from soaking anything from the next set. 1s should face the proper direction to resolve their tower (in this setup, everyone faces west).

To make it easy to keep track of who is who, I will leave their buffs as is.

The rest of the party stacks north to take Eye of the Tyrant (medium stack damage).

steps.label: Move+Lash
steps.note:
Gnash = move In.

3's move into position to soak towers where 1's placed them as they indicated during setup.

steps.label: 3s Soak+Gnash
steps.note:
Nidhogg clones will appear where towers were soaked.

They will target the closest player (should be the soaker) and lock in their position after a short time.

Later, they will do a large line AOE in that direction. We want to bait these lines out towards the wall. 

However, you need to dodge the 2nd part of Gnash/Lash first.

This is why you want towers as perfectly on the hitbox as possible.

Dodge Gnash/Lash.

steps.label: 2s Drop/3s Bait Lines
steps.note:
Bait the lines outwards. It can be tough to bait the line perfectly outside if lash just occurred; in this case, baiting it anywhere east, west, or south is acceptable. Never bait 1s and 3s north or through Nidstinien!

2's Place these two max melee northeast and northwest as you indicated during setup. Make sure to face west if you have arrows!

steps.label: East/West 1s Soaks+ Dodge Lines
steps.note:
Lines go off.

The two towers are soaked by the 1s who were the east and west towers; east 1 soaks east 2, west 1 soaks west 2.

Nidhogg also begins to cast Gnash and Lash or Lash and Gnash again.

steps.label: Line Bait
steps.note:
Aim the clones outwards.

Group 3 get into position to place your towers.

Everyone be ready for Gnash and Lash.

steps.label: 3 Placed
steps.note:
Once the castbar completes, #3 towers will be placed. Make sure to face west!

West tower will be soaked by 2 West. East tower will be soaked by 2 East. South tower will be soaked by 1 South.

You can begin moving into position to soak towers.

steps.label: Gnash
steps.note: Gnash, get out. 2s +South 1 go to soak - west is taken by west 2, east  is taken by east 2, and south is taken by south 1.

steps.label: Line bait
steps.note: Bait the dashes, and tank move  to an intercard to bait Nidstinien's line cleave autos away from the party.

steps.label: Drachenlance + Tower prepositions.
steps.note:
2 Cleaving tank-autos. Then he will face a random player to cast Drachenlance; move out of the way.

Position with your meteor partner at the clockwise intercardinal from your meteor position to prepare for tower soaks.

steps.label: Towers
steps.note:
Ranged always stay in your tower. Melee stay in your tower if it has two or more poles.

If your tower only has one pole and you are melee, flex into a neighboring tower in this priority:

1. Clockwise tower if it has more than two poles,
2. Counterclockwise tower if it has more than two poles,
3. The diagonally across tower if it has more than two poles.

Towers can spawn in several configs! Use your eyeballs and be prepared to flex.

steps.label: Resolve
steps.note:
3 of these 4 towers will spawn Nidstinien clones which will snap onto the nearest player, exactly as the previous towers did. Ranged should stand in the center of the tower to ensure the clones stare at them. Point the clones out intercardinally as they will also cast a line AE. After you bait your clone, collapse east or west.

One remaining tower, and the boss itself, will snap tethers onto random players. Assign a tank to grab each tether (usually one tank gets boss tether and one add tether). If you are tethered to a tower, collapse east or west so the tank can grab the tether from you easily.

Tethers are the single hardest hit in all of DSR. They require kitchen sink mits from tanks AND external cooldowns from healers. Tanks invulning tethers is also a common strategy.

Tanks can safely resolve tethers in the following positions:

1. Under the boss (invuln if stacking together),
2. Under the tower that extended the tether (the size of the AE is exactly the size of the base of the tower),
3. Directly north or south.

steps.label: Autos-Drachen-Enrage
steps.note:
Afterwards, cleaving autos resume on the main tank. Ensure MT is north or south so the group doesn't get cleaved.

There is one final Drachenlance before the enrage cast, and it is always pointed south. Generally if you push the boss to 8% or below before the enrage cast you will kill Nidstinien and move on to P4.
